title: Formation of phthalic anhydride from nighttime oxidation of various heterocyclic volatile organic compounds: implications for wildfire smoke
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, 5,962-972
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00065C, Communication
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kunpeng Chen, Raphael Mayorga, Linhui Tian, Roya Bahreini, Haofei Zhang, Ying-Hsuan Lin
This study shows phthalic anhydride formation from nighttime oxidation of heterocyclic volatile organic compounds, revealing new pathways with implications for wildfire smoke in air quality, climate, and health.
